scripts.validate: pnpm run validate:workspace && pnpm run harness:check && pnpm run architecture:check && pnpm run workflows:check && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.ci:foundation: pnpm run validate:workspace && pnpm run harness:check && pnpm run architecture:check && pnpm run workflows:check && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run build:packages && node --test scripts/foundation/*.test.mjs
scripts.ci:packages: pnpm run lint:packages && pnpm run typecheck:packages && pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @vocanova/api-client test
scripts.ci:web: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run typecheck:web && pnpm --filter @vocanova/web test:middleware && pnpm --filter @vocanova/web test:sentry && pnpm --filter @vocanova/web cloudflare:build && pnpm --filter @vocanova/web cloudflare:compatibility && pnpm --filter @vocanova/web cloudflare:typecheck && pnpm --filter @vocanova/web cloudflare:dry-run && pnpm --filter @vocanova/web cloudflare:limits && pnpm --filter @vocanova/web cloudflare:preview:test
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:packages && pnpm run lint:worker-api
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:packages && pnpm run typecheck:web && pnpm run typecheck:worker-api
scripts.test: pnpm run build:packages && node --test scripts/foundation/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @vocanova/api-client test && pnpm --filter @vocanova/web test:middleware && pnpm --filter @vocanova/api-worker test
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:worker-api
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml eslint.config.js apps/web apps/api-worker packages scripts/foundation docs AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md CONTRIBUTING.md README.md SECURITY.md .agents .claude .codex .cursor .opencode .playwright .vscode .github mise.toml .pre-commit-config.yaml
